propositions: Batch-path verdicts systematically carry confidence=0.0 despite successful judge_batch calls, causing aggregate to reject all pairs below the 0.7 threshold and surface zero findings.
output_token_limit=1024 truncates multi-candidate batches (K up to 20 candidates), causing the whole batch to abstain rather than return verdicts.
The batch entry contract lacked required fields (candidate_id, relation, confidence, abstain), allowing the model to omit or malform entries in multi-entry batches.
Live near-duplicate pairs that should surface with high confidence are not being detected due to the stacked defects in batching and token budgeting.
Unit tests pass despite the live feature never surfacing findings because they use canned runners that do not exercise the batch code path with real model outputs.
